samples.summary: weights reaches the Google Fonts URL unencoded and unvalidated, now via a mutable DOM data attribute
samples.evidence: familyParam interpolates weights raw: `family=${encodeURIComponent(family)}:wght@${weights ?? DEFAULT_WEIGHTS}` (font-catalog.ts:99). The new preview path feeds it from the DOM rather than a typed value: ensurePreviewFontLink(family, row.textContent ?? '', row.dataset.fontWeights) (more-fonts-dialog.tsx:151-155, font-family-picker.tsx:123-127), with the attribute written at more-fonts-dialog.tsx:237 and font-family-picker.tsx:221/251. previewWeight only splits on ';' and trims (font-catalog.ts:184-187) and never checks the value is numeric, so a weights string containing &, ? or # is injected verbatim into the css2 query: e.g. '400&family=Other:wght@400&text=abc' appends extra family=/text= parameters, and a # truncates &display=swap into a fragment. The chain is incomplete today: every writer of data-font-weights reads entry.weights from the statically bundled catalog (font-catalog.data.ts, font-catalog.full.ts), so an attacker needs script execution to set the attribute, and the URL origin/path is hardcoded so nothing can be redirected off fonts.googleapis.com. Hardening: encodeURIComponent the weights segment, or reject anything outside /^[0-9]+(;[0-9]+)*$/ before building the href — this value now crosses an untyped, externally mutable boundary (a DOM attribute) that it did not cross before this change.

samples.summary: New third-party egress channel: arbitrary DOM textContent is forwarded to fonts.googleapis.com in the text= query with no whitelist or length cap
samples.evidence: ensurePreviewFontLink ships whatever string it is handed to a third-party origin: `text=${encodeURIComponent(subset)}` (font-catalog.ts:237), and both callers source that string from live DOM (row.textContent ?? '', more-fonts-dialog.tsx:153, font-family-picker.tsx:125) rather than from a catalog field — the doc-comment at font-catalog.ts:212-215 makes 'read the row's rendered text' the explicit contract. For today's rows the text is a catalog label plus group name, or (recents path, font-family-picker.tsx:231) entry?.label ?? family where family is a localStorage value validated only as typeof x === 'string' (font-recents.ts:43-45); nothing sensitive currently leaves the origin, and the pre-existing ensureFontLink already revealed family names by URL. The weakness is the missing constraint: any future row that paints user content (a 'preview with your own text' field, a document-derived family name, a per-file 'fonts used here' list) would silently exfiltrate that content to Google in a GET URL, and there is no length bound so a long row yields an over-long URL. Hardening: derive the subset from the known label/group strings (or intersect row text with a catalog-derived allowlist) and cap its length instead of accepting arbitrary DOM text.
